# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of copper
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data copper_structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Minimize the structure
min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small deformations and calculate stress
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over strain modes
variable i loop 6
label loop_start

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0 0"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_delta 0"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_delta"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_delta v_delta"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0 v_delta"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta v_delta 0"

# Run simulation
run 0

# Calculate stress
variable stress equal "-pxx -pyy -pzz"
print "${stress}"

# Next strain mode
next i
jump SELF loop_start

# End of script

# LAMMPS input script for calculating the bulk modulus of silicon

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data silicon.data

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/ffield.reax.SiO Si

fix 1 all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reax/c

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small deformations and calculate stress
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over strain modes
label loop
variable i loop 6

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0.0 0.0 units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0.0 v_delta 0.0 units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0.0 0.0 v_delta units box"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0.0 v_delta v_delta units box"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0.0 v_delta units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta v_delta 0.0 units box"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Calculate stress
compute stress all stress/atom NULL

# Next strain mode
next i
jump SELF loop

# Output results
thermo_style custom step temp press pxx pyy pzz pyz pxz pxy
thermo 100

run 0
